good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Australia is wider than the Moon.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 A day on Venus is longer than its whole year.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 A bolt of lightning can be about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 A teaspoon of neutron star would weigh about a billion tons on Earth.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Wombats poop in little cubes, which helps the droppings stay put on rocks and logs.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 There's a village in Norway called Hell, and it freezes over most winters.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Some kinds of bamboo can grow nearly 90 cm (3 feet) in a single day.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 The footprints on the Moon could last for millions of years - there's no wind to blow them away.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Koala fingerprints are so similar to ours that they can be hard to tell apart, even under a microscope.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Istanbul sits on two continents at once: Europe and Asia.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 There are more trees on Earth (about 3 trillion) than stars in the Milky Way.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth, so you always see the Sun as it was 8 minutes ago.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Butterflies taste with their feet.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 The world's shortest scheduled flight, between two Scottish islands, takes about 90 seconds.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Rainbows are actually full circles. From the ground, the horizon hides the bottom half.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Saturn is less dense than water. In a big enough bathtub, it would float.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Crows can recognize individual human faces and remember them for years.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Sealed honey can last for thousands of years - pots of it have turned up in ancient Egyptian tombs.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Astronauts say space smells like seared steak, hot metal and welding fumes.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Dolphins use signature whistles that work a lot like names.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 France spans 12 time zones, more than any other country, thanks to its overseas territories.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 A pineapple plant takes about two years to grow a single pineapple.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm that's bigger than Earth.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 A shrimp's heart is in its head.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Lake Baikal in Siberia holds roughly a fifth of all the unfrozen fresh surface water on Earth.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Snowflakes almost always have six sides or six arms.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Owls can't move their eyes, so they turn their heads up to 270 degrees instead.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 The Eiffel Tower grows up to about 15 cm (6 inches) taller in summer as its iron expands.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Young sunflowers follow the Sun across the sky all day, then turn back east overnight.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 The Space Station circles Earth every 90 minutes or so, so astronauts see about 16 sunrises a day.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Male seahorses are the ones who carry the babies and give birth.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Around 6,000 years ago the Sahara was green, with lakes, grasslands and hippos.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Most of the ocean floor still hasn't been mapped in high detail.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Olympus Mons, a volcano on Mars, is about two and a half times taller than Mount Everest.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Giraffes have seven neck bones - the same number as you.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Alaska is the most northern, western and eastern US state all at once.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Forgetful squirrels help plant forests: some of the nuts they bury and never dig up sprout into trees.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Uranus spins on its side, tipped over at about 98 degrees.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Sharks have been around longer than trees.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Russia stretches across 11 time zones.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Peanuts aren't nuts - they're legumes, like beans and peas.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Sunsets on Mars glow blue.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Polar bears have black skin, and their fur isn't really white - each hair is see-through.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 Vatican City is the smallest country in the world - smaller than many city parks.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 One of the oldest known living trees, a bristlecone pine in California, is over 4,800 years old.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Halley's Comet swings past Earth about every 76 years. Its next visit is in 2061.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Sea otters sometimes hold paws while they sleep so they don't drift apart.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 The Dead Sea is so salty that you float without even trying.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Coral reefs cover less than 1% of the ocean floor but are home to about a quarter of all ocean species.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Astronomers estimate there are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on all of Earth's beaches.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🐾 Axolotls can regrow lost legs, and even parts of their heart and brain.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌍 More than a third of everyone on Earth lives in just two countries: India and China.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🌿 Venus flytraps can count: they only snap shut after their trigger hairs are touched twice.

good_morning_fun_fact.title: Good morning!
good_morning_fun_fact.body: 🚀 Earth isn't a perfect ball - it bulges at the equator because it spins.

morning_explore.title: Today's mini adventure
morning_explore.body: Pick one street, park or shop you've never been to and check it out today.

morning_explore.title: New route, new finds
morning_explore.body: Take a different way to wherever you're going today. See what you spot.

morning_explore.title: Coffee with a view
morning_explore.body: Grab a coffee somewhere new and drink it outside.

morning_explore.title: Explore like a local
morning_explore.body: Ask a barista or shop owner for their favorite spot nearby, then go.

morning_explore.title: Free is fun
morning_explore.body: Free museums, parks, public gardens - your city has more free stuff than you think.

morning_explore.title: Garden check
morning_explore.body: Look up a botanical or community garden near you. Perfect for a slow morning.

morning_explore.title: Library field trip
morning_explore.body: Big city libraries are often stunning buildings. Go take a look inside.

morning_explore.title: Climb for the view
morning_explore.body: Find the highest point in your city - a hill, a tower, a top-floor café - and look out.

morning_explore.title: Neighborhood bingo
morning_explore.body: Walk through a neighborhood you've never visited. Bonus points for a new café.

morning_explore.title: Sunset plans
morning_explore.body: Pick a spot you've never watched the sunset from and go this week.

morning_explore.title: Pop-up hunt
morning_explore.body: Pop-up markets and shops come and go. See what's popping up near you.

morning_explore.title: Wander a little
morning_explore.body: Take a 20-minute walk in a direction you never go.

morning_explore.title: Local landmark day
morning_explore.body: There's a landmark in your city you've never actually visited. Today's the day.

morning_explore.title: Thrift treasure hunt
morning_explore.body: Pop into a vintage or thrift shop you've never been in. Treasure hunting counts.

morning_explore.title: Green space reset
morning_explore.body: Start the day in a park you don't usually go to. Fresh air, new view.

morning_explore.title: Architecture walk
morning_explore.body: Find the most interesting building near you and go see it up close.

morning_explore.title: Two wheels
morning_explore.body: Rent a bike or scooter and explore a part of town you'd never walk to.

morning_explore.title: Gallery hop
morning_explore.body: Small galleries are usually free to walk into. Find one near you this week.

morning_explore.title: Tourist for a day
morning_explore.body: What would a visitor do in your city? Do one of those things this week.

morning_explore.title: Find your third place
morning_explore.body: Not home, not work: a café, a bench, a bookstore. Go find your spot.

morning_explore.title: Water day
morning_explore.body: Find a fountain, pond, beach or riverwalk near you and spend some time there.

morning_explore.title: Check the calendar
morning_explore.body: Festivals, fairs, free concerts - see what's on in your city this week.

morning_explore.title: Explore your own block
morning_explore.body: There's a spot within 10 minutes of home you've never noticed. Go look.

morning_explore.title: Sculpture spotting
morning_explore.body: Public art hides in plain sight. Find a statue or sculpture you've never really looked at.

morning_explore.title: Weekend scouting
morning_explore.body: Pick one new place to explore this weekend and add it to a list on Afiyeat.

morning_explore.title: Step inside
morning_explore.body: That place you always walk past but never go into? Go in today.

morning_explore.title: Historic stroll
morning_explore.body: Find your city's oldest street or district and take a walk through it.

morning_explore.title: Photo walk
morning_explore.body: Go on a walk just to take photos. You'll notice things you've passed for years.

morning_explore.title: Hidden courtyards
morning_explore.body: Cities are full of hidden courtyards and rooftop gardens. Go find one.

morning_explore.title: Start an explore list
morning_explore.body: Make an Afiyeat list of places in your city you want to visit, and tick one off.

evening_explore.title: Golden hour is coming
evening_explore.body: Find a park, rooftop or riverside spot with a view and catch the sunset.

evening_explore.title: Be a tourist at home
evening_explore.body: Pick one spot in your city you've never been to and go this week.

evening_explore.title: Museum mood
evening_explore.body: Lots of museums have free or late nights. See what's on near you this week.

evening_explore.title: Take the long way
evening_explore.body: Walk a street you've never walked. The best finds hide one block over.

evening_explore.title: Night market hunt
evening_explore.body: Night markets, food halls, late bazaars - find one and wander through.

evening_explore.title: New neighborhood unlocked
evening_explore.body: Pick a neighborhood you only know by name and spend an evening there.

evening_explore.title: Bookstore wander
evening_explore.body: Get lost in an indie bookstore. Leave with something you didn't plan on.

evening_explore.title: Hidden green
evening_explore.body: Your city has a park you've never set foot in. Go find it.

evening_explore.title: What's on tonight?
evening_explore.body: Live music, comedy, a gallery opening - see what's happening near you.

evening_explore.title: Look up
evening_explore.body: On your next walk, look above street level. Old signs, murals and rooftops are everywhere.

evening_explore.title: Ride somewhere new
evening_explore.body: Take a bus or train line you never use and hop off somewhere new.

evening_explore.title: Street art safari
evening_explore.body: Hunt down a mural or two in your city, then add a spot nearby to your list.

evening_explore.title: Waterfront walk
evening_explore.body: River, lake or harbor - head to the water and take a slow lap.

evening_explore.title: Neon & signs
evening_explore.body: Find the best old neon sign in your city. Evenings are when they shine.

evening_explore.title: Ferry, tram or cable car
evening_explore.body: If your city has one, ride it at dusk just for the view.

evening_explore.title: After-dark stroll
evening_explore.body: Some streets look completely different lit up. Take an evening walk somewhere new.

evening_explore.title: Say yes to the detour
evening_explore.body: That spot you pass on your commute? Today's the day you stop in.

evening_explore.title: Window shopping, upgraded
evening_explore.body: Wander a street of small shops you've never browsed.

evening_explore.title: Evening picnic
evening_explore.body: Grab something from a local deli or bakery and eat it in a park.

evening_explore.title: Dinner in a new neighborhood
evening_explore.body: Pick a restaurant somewhere you've never explored and make an evening of it.

evening_explore.title: New café, new corner
evening_explore.body: Try a café in a part of town you never visit. Grab a window seat and people-watch.

evening_explore.title: Live music check
evening_explore.body: Find a small venue with live music this week. Jazz, open mic, anything goes.

evening_explore.title: Rooftop hunt
evening_explore.body: Rooftops, terraces, top-floor cafés - find a high spot for tonight's sky.

evening_explore.title: Stargazing spot
evening_explore.body: Find a park away from the brightest city lights and look up after dark.

evening_explore.title: Main street, new town
evening_explore.body: Walk the main street of a neighborhood you only know from the car window.

evening_explore.title: Late sweet stop
evening_explore.body: Track down a dessert shop open late in a part of town you rarely visit.

evening_explore.title: Bridge at dusk
evening_explore.body: Walk across a bridge in your city around sunset. The view is usually worth it.

evening_explore.title: Cinema night
evening_explore.body: Find an independent cinema or an outdoor screening near you.

evening_explore.title: Small stages
evening_explore.body: Small theaters and comedy clubs are local treasures. See what's on this week.

evening_explore.title: City lights
evening_explore.body: Head somewhere known for its lights - a skyline view, a lit-up square, a busy avenue.

evening_explore.title: Tea house hideaway
evening_explore.body: Find a quiet tea house or café you've never been to and take the evening slow.

evening_explore.title: Weekend explore plan
evening_explore.body: Pick one neighborhood for the weekend and save three spots there on Afiyeat.

evening_explore.title: Food hall wander
evening_explore.body: A food hall is a whole neighborhood under one roof. Go explore one.

evening_explore.title: Plaza people-watching
evening_explore.body: Find a busy square, grab a bench and watch the city go by.

evening_explore.title: Off the main road
evening_explore.body: Every city has a spot down an alley or up a staircase. Go find one.

evening_explore.title: Festival check
evening_explore.body: Fairs and street festivals pop up all year. See if one's on near you.

evening_explore.title: Evening market
evening_explore.body: Some markets come alive after work. Find one and browse with no plan.

evening_explore.title: Historic quarter at night
evening_explore.body: Old town, historic district, cobbled lane - they glow after dark. Go see.

evening_explore.title: Ask the locals
evening_explore.body: Ask someone who lives nearby for their favorite hidden spot, then go this week.

evening_explore.title: Save your find
evening_explore.body: Explored somewhere new today? Save it on Afiyeat so you can find it again.
